name: Cursor Trail Loader
title: Cursor Trail Loader
description: A rolling loading counter with a cursor-driven image trail and a smooth upward content reveal.
summary: Move the cursor while loading to leave a layered trail of images that ease into place, tilt with movement, and fade away. A rolling counter settles at 100 before the loading curtain lifts to reveal the page. Configure image geometry, trail density, timing, colors, progress, and replay.
highlights: Cursor-driven image trail with velocity-based tilt
Reusable bounded image pool with smooth fading
Existing Animated Counter reused for rolling digits
Automatic and controlled progress with pause and replay
Reduced-motion fallback and scoped animation cleanup
anatomy: Rolling progress counter in the lower-right corner

physics.description: GSAP quickTo reuses pointer-follow tweens. Each image card has a reusable entrance, hold, and fade timeline. Distance-based spawning limits trail density. A scoped master timeline controls progress stages and the curtain reveal; the existing Animated Counter handles rolling digits.

accessibility.aria: Loading progress is labeled. Trail images are decorative and pointer-transparent. Page content stays inert until loading completes.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Cursor trails and curtain movement are disabled. Automatic loading reveals content immediately; controlled loading waits for progress to reach 100.

bestPractices: Connect progress to real loading work when used in production.
Keep automatic loading short and provide pause or replay for demos.
Cursor trails require a fine hover pointer; loading and content reveal also work without hover.

props.name: images
props.description: Image URLs for the decorative cursor trail. Loaded images cycle in order; failed images are skipped.

props.name: children
props.description: Content revealed when loading completes.

props.name: progress
props.description: Controlled loading progress from 0 to 100. Omit for automatic progress.

props.name: duration
props.description: Automatic loading duration in seconds.

props.name: revealDuration
props.description: Duration of the upward curtain reveal in seconds.

props.name: imageSize
props.description: Trail image width in pixels, constrained to the container.

props.name: imageAspectRatio
props.description: Image width divided by height.

props.name: trailLength
props.description: Maximum number of image cards in the reusable trail pool.

props.name: trailSpacing
props.description: Cursor travel distance in pixels before the next image appears.

props.name: trailLifetime
props.description: Image hold before fading, in seconds.

props.name: followDuration
props.description: Cursor-follow smoothing duration in seconds.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Maximum image tilt in degrees.

props.name: borderRadius
props.description: Image corner radius in pixels.

props.name: background
props.description: Loading curtain background color.

props.name: foreground
props.description: Loading counter color.

props.name: paused
props.description: Pause or resume the loader and active image animations.

props.name: replayKey
props.description: Change to restart loading from zero.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible progress label.

props.name: className
props.description: Container size and styling classes.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once after the content is revealed.
